description: This file defines a React functional component 'AddTagOption' used for adding and managing tags linked to selected items within a web application. It includes UI elements like menus, icons, and popovers, and interacts with controllers for navigation and linking.

methods.name: toggleMenu
methods.description: Toggles the open state of the tag menu.

methods.name: isTagLinkedToSelectedItems
methods.description: Checks if a given tag is linked to all selected items.

methods.name: linkTagToSelectedItems
methods.description: Links a tag to all selected items.

methods.name: unlinkTagFromSelectedItems
methods.description: Unlinks a tag from all selected items.
